items.question: How far in advance should I make my appointment?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“How far in advance should I make my appointment?”，自然应答是“Well, this is our busiest time of year.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（Well, this is our busiest time of year.）。
